claims: The 2026 iPhone lineup is expected as the iPhone 18 series.
Latest rumors for the 2026 iPhone lineup indicate a potential late 2026 release for a foldable "iPhone Fold" (or Ultra).
The 2026 flagship Pro models are rumored to feature advanced 2nm A20 chips.
The 2026 flagship Pro models are rumored to feature under-display Face ID for a smaller Dynamic Island.
The 2026 flagship Pro models are rumored to feature a variable aperture camera.
